item.text: The resolver currently reads only grants declared directly on each assigned role, so it ignores the `parent` link. I’ll add recursive inheritance while guarding against missing parents and cycles, and cover the auditor download case with a regression test.

Inheritance now resolves parent grants transitively, and the visited-role set prevents a malformed cycle from looping forever. I’m checking the existing test command and running the report tests for the new auditor case.
